corpus_description: Controlled Pairs Corpus: 5 Traditional Indonesian Instrumental Non-Vocal Music Styles
purpose: Evaluation of AI synthetic music detection and TreeSHAP acoustic attribution on authentic vs synthetic Indonesian regional instruments, matching acoustic prompts and eliminating recording/vocal confounding variables.
research_question: RM 3: Kinerja deteksi dan atribusi TreeSHAP pada korpus pasangan terkendali musik instrumental daerah Indonesia tanpa vokal

pairs.suno_prompt: traditional Javanese gamelan instrumental, authentic bronze metallophone bonang saron gong ageng kendang, slendro pelog tuning, rhythmic acoustic percussion, meditative classical court music, acoustic room acoustics, no vocals, purely instrumental
pairs.key_acoustic_markers: Peluruhan nada logam harmonik tinggi (>5 kHz), resonansi transien kendang, mikro-dinamika pukulan tabuh fisik.

pairs.instrument_family: Idiofon bilah bambu beresonator tabung (Bamboo Xylophone)
pairs.suno_prompt: Balinese rindik bamboo instrumental, fast interlocking bamboo xylophone notes kotekan, traditional Balinese acoustic melody, gentle bamboo resonance, tropical acoustic folk music, natural organic room tone, no vocals, purely instrumental
pairs.key_acoustic_markers: Transien perkusi ketukan bilah bambu cepat, resonansi berongga tabung bambu, variasi dinamika artikulasi tangan.

pairs.region: Pulau Rote, Nusa Tenggara Timur (NTT), Indonesia
pairs.instrument_family: Kordofon tabung dawai petik beresonator daun lontar (Plucked Tube Zither with Palm Resonator)
pairs.suno_prompt: traditional Indonesian sasando plucked string instrumental, acoustic harp with lontar palm leaf resonance, intricate fingerpicking, melodious Indonesian traditional melody, ambient acoustic timbre, natural decay, no singing, no vocals, purely instrumental
pairs.key_acoustic_markers: Artikulasi petikan dawai nilon/baja, dengung spasial resonator daun lontar alami, harmonik senar berdengung.

pairs.instrument_family: Idiofon tabung bambu goyang (Shaken Tuned Bamboo Tubes)
pairs.suno_prompt: Sundanese angklung bamboo ensemble instrumental, shaken bamboo tubes rattling acoustic harmony, traditional West Javanese rhythmic melody, cheerful acoustic folk, natural hall acoustics, no vocals, instrumental only
pairs.key_acoustic_markers: Karakteristik getaran berderik (rattle) tabung bambu, pergeseran fasa mikro antar-tabung goyang, modulasi amplitudo sinusoidal.

pairs.instrument_family: Idiofon bilah kayu beresonator kotak (Wooden Xylophone Ensemble)
pairs.suno_prompt: Minahasan kolintang wooden xylophone instrumental, traditional North Sulawesi acoustic wooden percussion ensemble, melodic wooden bars resonance, upbeat polyphonic Indonesian traditional, wooden mallet strike, instrumental only, no vocals
pairs.key_acoustic_markers: Kekasaran perkusi ketukan kayu padat (solid wood transients), resonansi kotak kayu penopang, spektrum frekuensi rendah pada bilah bass.
